page: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v5 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 32 virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor offering 16 dedicated physical cores with 2 threads per core at speeds up to 3.7 GHz. Hardware caches include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Storage is bundled with 1288 GB of local SSD space, while hardware GPU acceleration is not included.

Benchmark results highlight solid performance across memory and single-core compute tasks. The stress-ng single-core test reaches 2702.58, and the PassMark memory benchmark reaches 2770.39, placing both in the top 25% of measured systems. Multi-core performance aligns within the middle 50%, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 12683.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 38088.4. Small model LLM inference demonstrates top 10% throughput for text generation at 334.98 tokens per second, but larger 70B models show weaker processing speeds at 6.54 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated vector or matrix extensions like AVX-512 or AMX.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E32ads_v5 offers a competitive allocation of memory and temporary storage per virtual core without requiring add-on charges for fast local scratch space. Tradeoffs include modest memory bandwidth for large uncached operations (76.87 GB/sec read and 40.41 GB/sec write) and absence of advanced instruction sets like AVX-512. The configuration is primarily tailored for enterprise relational databases, large in-memory caches such as Redis, big data analytics engines, and high-concurrency web backends.
description: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine equipped with 32 vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, backed by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.7 GHz across 16 physical cores. It features 1288 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage and operates without a dedicated GPU. Performance data indicates strong single-core compute and PassMark memory metrics within the top quartile, alongside solid multi-core execution and high-throughput Redis operations reaching 32.01 million operations per second. The instance achieves balanced memory density suitable for intermediate-to-large memory workloads, though it lacks AVX-512 support and displays reduced throughput on 70B parameter LLM inference. Microsoft Azure E32ads_v5 is well suited for in-memory databases, memory-bound caching clusters, analytics processing, and data-intensive business applications.
